description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds, ms, µs or ns — auto-detected from the number of digits, or set "unit") or a date string to ISO 8601 (UTC and in a timezone), RFC 7231 / UTC string, local time in any IANA timezone with its offset, relative time ("3 hours ago"), day of year, ISO week, and Unix seconds/ms. A wall-clock time without an offset (e.g. "2026-10-26T14:30") is read in "timezone". Also shows the same instant in extra "zones" (world clock). No value = now. Date arithmetic is not done here. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/timestamp-convert/

now.description: Reference "now" in Unix ms for the relative time. Default: the current time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the local view and for wall-clock input. Default: the server's (UTC).

unit.description: Unit of a numeric timestamp. Default: auto-detect.

value.description: A Unix timestamp (e.g. 1700000000 or "1700000000123"), an ISO/RFC date string, or a wall-clock "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]". Default: now.

zones.description: Extra IANA timezones to show the same instant in, e.g. ["UTC","Asia/Tokyo"].

name: time_convert
title: Timestamp convert
